records.name: Ebenezer Maxwell Mansion
records.summary: A Victorian house museum in Germantown that shows nineteenth century home life through its rooms, gardens and collections. It also runs guided tours, Victorian theatre, lectures, book clubs and family events, and it looks for volunteers in tours, collections and events.
records.what_you_do: Take a guided house tour on a weekend, see a Victorian theatre show or a free family event, or volunteer as a tour guide or helper through the museum's volunteer form.

schedule.text: Tours run Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays at noon, 1, 2 and 3 pm. Thursday tours are by advance reservation only.

cost.text: Guided tours are $10 per person. Some events are free and others have their own prices.

access.notes: The house is fully air conditioned, according to the visit page.

first_step.how: Reserve a Friday, Saturday or Sunday tour at noon, 1, 2 or 3 pm on the museum's online ticketing page; reservations are appreciated.
first_step.basis: Public weekend tours need no application, and the museum trains its tour guides and says no professional historian background is needed to volunteer.
first_step.what_to_expect: A tour takes you through the rooms of the Victorian house, and the gardens around it are open to stroll. Guides are trained by the museum, so you do not need a history background to lead one. A tour costs $10 per person, and reservations are appreciated.
first_visit_tips: Book on the online ticketing page; groups of six or more can book any day by phone or email.
The Thursday tours need an advance reservation, so do not arrive without one.

records.notes: Tour days conflict between pages: the visit page's main text lists Thursday tours at noon, 1 and 2 pm, while the homepage and the visit sidebar list Friday to Sunday at noon, 1, 2 and 3 pm, with Thursdays by reservation only; the record follows the homepage. The October 2026 events on the homepage (Historic Germantown Second Saturday on October 10, the Sleepy Hollow play on October 23 to 25, Trick or Treating on October 31) carry no year, and the events page shows no upcoming events, so the 2026-10 sign of life is carried from tier 1 and is not confirmed by a dated line. The executive director's name replaces the contact name carried from tier 1, per the site. A volunteer page publishes a director's personal email, which is left out. The proposed Victorian Society Philadelphia Chapter is a plan the museum would host, not a group taking members, so it is dropped from this batch. Historic Germantown's shared OnePass ticket is a ticket pass, not a group, and is dropped. Several menu links on the staff and Black History pages point to unrelated gambling sites and were skipped.
